                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xuliuzai/p/19656906" title="发布于 2026-03-01 23:32">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">MySQL 慢日志统计分析利器---pt-query-digest</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h3>1. 概述</h3>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">pt-query-digest&nbsp;是 Percona Toolkit 中最强大、最常用的 MySQL/MariaDB 性能分析工具。它的核心作用是将杂乱的慢查询日志（Slow Query Log）、通用日志（General Log）甚至实时流量（tcpdump/PROCESSLIST）转化为<span class="qk-md-strong complete">可读性极强的统计报告<span class="qk-md-text complete">，帮助你快速定位“最耗资源”的 SQL 语句。</span></span></span></p>
<h4 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i7.96a07551oiYCIg">核心功能</span></h4>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">指纹化（Fingerprinting）<span class="qk-md-text complete">：自动将具体的 SQL 语句参数化（例如将 SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=1 和 id=2 归为一类 SELECT * FROM users WHERE id=?），从而统计同类查询的总耗时和频率。</span></span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">多维度排序<span class="qk-md-text complete">：默认按<span class="qk-md-strong complete">总响应时间<span class="qk-md-text complete">排序，也可以按执行次数、锁等待时间、IO 等待时间等排序。</span></span></span></span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">多数据源支持<span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span></span></span>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">慢查询日志文件&nbsp;(slow.log)</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">通用日志&nbsp;(general.log)</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">MySQL 进程列表&nbsp;(SHOW PROCESSLIST)</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">TCP 抓包数据&nbsp;(tcpdump)</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">Binary Log&nbsp;(需先用 mysqlbinlog 转为文本)</span></li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">2. 安装方式</span></span></span></h3>
<h4 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i22.96a07551oiYCIg">常用方式 直接下载单文件</span></h4>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>### step <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 下载脚本 在终端执行以下命令（确保服务器能访问外网）
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">wget</span> https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">www.percona.com/get/pt-query-digest</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
### step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 赋予执行权限
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">chmod</span> +x pt-query-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">digest

### Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 移动到系统路径（可选）
## 为了方便在任何目录下都能直接输入 pt</span>-query-digest 命令，建议将其移动到 /usr/local/bin 或 /usr/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">bin 
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">mv</span> pt-query-digest /usr/local/bin/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

### Step </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 验证安装 
##输入以下命令查看版本，若输出版本号则成功：
pt</span>-query-digest --version</pre>
</div>
<h4 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i23.96a07551oiYCIg">通过包管理器安装</span></h4>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i23.96a07551oiYCIg"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i25.96a07551oiYCIg">如果你不仅需要 pt-query-digest，还需要 Percona Toolkit 中的其他工具（如 pt-online-schema-change, pt-table-checksum 等），建议直接安装整个工具包。</span></span></p>
<p>需要先配置 Percona 的 YUM 源，然后安装：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># 安装 Percona 仓库配置包 (以 CentOS <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 为例，具体版本请参照官网)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> https:<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">repo.percona.com/yum/percona-release-latest.noarch.rpm</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
# 刷新缓存并安装
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> makecache fast
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> percona-toolkit</pre>
</div>
<h4 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i29.96a07551oiYCIg">安装时常见问题与依赖处理</span></h4>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i29.96a07551oiYCIg">如果在运行 pt-query-digest 时遇到类似 Can't locate DBI.pm 或 Can't locate Digest/MD5.pm 的错误，说明缺少 Perl 模块。</span></p>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sudo</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">yum</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">install</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">perl</span>-DBI <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">perl</span>-Digest-MD5 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">perl</span>-Time-HiRes <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">perl</span>-Term-ReadKey</pre>
</div>
<h3>3.&nbsp;<span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i32.96a07551oiYCIg">常用参数速查表</span></h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr><th align="left">参数</th><th align="left">说明</th><th align="left">示例</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td align="left"><code>--since</code></td>
<td align="left">只分析指定时间之后的日志</td>
<td align="left"><code>--since '2h'</code> (最近2小时), <code>--since '2026-03-01 10:00:00'</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td align="left"><code>--until</code></td>
<td align="left">只分析指定时间之前的日志</td>
<td align="left"><code>--until '1h'</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td align="left"><code>--limit</code></td>
<td align="left">限制输出的报告条目数</td>
<td align="left"><code>--limit 5</code> (只看前5名)</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td align="left"><code>--order-by</code></td>
<td align="left">排序依据</td>
<td align="left"><code>--order-by query_time</code> (默认), <code>--order-by rows_examined</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td align="left"><code>--filter</code></td>
<td align="left">过滤特定语句 (Perl 表达式)</td>
<td align="left"><code>--filter '$event-&gt;{db} eq "production"'</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td align="left"><code>--output</code></td>
<td align="left">输出格式</td>
<td align="left"><code>--output json</code>, <code>--output csv</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td align="left"><code>--no-report</code></td>
<td align="left">不生成详细报告，仅生成摘要或存库</td>
<td align="left">配合 <code>--review</code> 使用</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3>4.&nbsp;<span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i33.96a07551oiYCIg">输出报告内容格式</span></h3>
<p>&nbsp;<span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i36.96a07551oiYCIg">报告通常分为三个主要部分：<span class="qk-md-strong complete">总体统计（Overall）<span class="qk-md-text complete">、<span class="qk-md-strong complete">查询概要（Profile）<span class="qk-md-text complete">和<span class="qk-md-strong complete">详细查询报告（Query Report）<span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h4 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i37.96a07551oiYCIg">4.1 总体统计 (Overall)</span></h4>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i37.96a07551oiYCIg">这是报告的开头部分，展示了日志文件的全局概况。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># Rank  Query ID           Response <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">time</span>   Calls  R/Call  V/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">M   Item
# </span>====  =================  ==============  =====  =======  =====  =====================================<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x8F2A3B1C</span>...      <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">120</span>.5s (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90.2</span>%)  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span>    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>.205s  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.02</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">   SELECT users WHERE ...
#    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x1B3C4D5E</span>...       <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>.2s (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">7.6</span>%)    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">50</span>     <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>.204s  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.01</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">   UPDATE orders SET ...
#    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x9A8B7C6D</span>...        <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>.9s (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2.2</span>%)   <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">200</span>    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>.015s  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0.00</span>   INSERT INTO logs ...</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;<span class="qk-md-strong complete">关键字段解析：</span></p>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">Rank<span class="qk-md-text complete">: 排名。默认按<span class="qk-md-strong complete">总响应时间<span class="qk-md-text complete">从高到低排序（最耗时的排第一）。</span></span></span></span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">Query ID<span class="qk-md-text complete">: 查询指纹的哈希值。相同的 SQL 结构（参数不同）会有相同的 ID。</span></span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">Response time<span class="qk-md-text complete">:</span></span></span>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;120.5s: 该类查询消耗的总时间。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">(90.2%):&nbsp;<span class="qk-md-strong complete">最重要指标<span class="qk-md-text complete">。表示该类查询占总耗时量的百分比。如果前几名加起来超过 80%，优化它们就能解决大部分性能问题。</span></span></span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">Calls<span class="qk-md-text complete">: 执行次数。</span></span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">R/Call (Response time per Call)<span class="qk-md-text complete">: 平均每次执行的耗时。如果这个值很大，说明单次查询就很慢；如果很小但总时间长，说明是频率太高（如循环查询）。</span></span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">V/M (Variation to Mean)<span class="qk-md-text complete">: 方差与均值的比率。</span></span></span>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">值越接近 0，说明执行时间很稳定。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">值越大（如 &gt; 1），说明执行时间波动极大（有时快，有时极慢），可能涉及锁等待或资源争抢。</span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">Item<span class="qk-md-text complete">: 该类别的代表性 SQL 语句摘要（已参数化）。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<h4 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete">4.2 查询概要 (Profile)</span></h4>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">这部分以表格形式展示了更细致的统计分布，帮助你判断是“偶尔慢”还是“一直慢”。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># Rank  Query ID           Response <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">time</span>   Calls  R/Call  Row examine/d  Row send/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">d  Version
# </span>====  =================  ==============  =====  =======  =============  ==========  =======<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#    </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0x8F2A3B1C</span>...      <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">120</span>.5s (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90.2</span>%)  <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span>    <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>.205s   <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.2M</span>/12k       <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>       <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5.7</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">25</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">关键指标解读：</span></div>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">Row examine/d (Rows Examined per call)<span class="qk-md-text complete">: 平均每次查询扫描的行数。</span></span></span>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">优化重点<span class="qk-md-text complete">：如果扫描行数（examine）远大于返回行数（send），例如扫描 100 万行只返回 1 行，通常意味着<span class="qk-md-strong complete">缺少索引<span class="qk-md-text complete">或<span class="qk-md-strong complete">索引失效<span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">Row send/d (Rows Sent per call)<span class="qk-md-text complete">: 平均每次查询返回给客户端的行数。</span></span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">Version<span class="qk-md-text complete">: 执行该查询时的 MySQL 版本（如果日志中包含）。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<h4 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i47.96a07551oiYCIg">4.3 详细查询报告 (Query Report) -&nbsp;<span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">核心部分</span></span></span></h4>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i47.96a07551oiYCIg">这是最有价值的部分，针对排名前几位的 SQL 进行深度剖析。</span></p>
<h5 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i49.96a07551oiYCIg">A. 统计分布 (Statistics)</span></h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># Statistics
#  Count    : </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
#  Exec </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">time</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">: 120s total, 1s avg, 2s min, 50s max, 95th percentile: 5s, 99th: 10s
#  Lock </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">time</span>: <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.5s total, 5ms avg, 0s min, 100ms max
#  Rows sent: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">100</span> total, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> avg
#  Rows exam: 120M total, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1.2M</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> avg
#  Sizes:     </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> bytes total, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span> bytes avg</pre>
</div>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">Exec time (执行时间)<span class="qk-md-text complete">:</span></span></span>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">avg:&nbsp;平均值。</span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">min / max:&nbsp;最小/最大耗时。如果&nbsp;<code class="qk-md-code">max</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;远大于&nbsp;<code class="qk-md-code">avg</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">，需排查偶发卡顿。</span></span></span></span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">95th percentile (P95):&nbsp;95% 的请求都在这个时间内完成。<span class="qk-md-strong complete">比平均值更有参考价值<span class="qk-md-text complete">，因为它排除了极端异常值的影响。</span></span></span></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">Lock time (锁等待时间)<span class="qk-md-text complete">: 如果锁等待时间占比很高，说明存在严重的锁竞争（死锁或长事务阻塞）。</span></span></li>
<li class="qk-md-li complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i51.96a07551oiYCIg"><span class="qk-md-strong complete">Rows exam vs Rows sent<span class="qk-md-text complete">: 再次强调扫描行数与返回行数的比例，确认索引效率。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<h5 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i52.96a07551oiYCIg">B. 指纹化 SQL (Fingerprint)</span></h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># Fingerprint
SELECT </span>* FROM users WHERE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span> = ? AND status = ?</pre>
</div>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">具体的数字/字符串被替换为&nbsp;?<span class="qk-md-text complete">。这告诉你这类查询的结构。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<h5 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i55.96a07551oiYCIg">C. 具体示例 (Example)</span></h5>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># Example
SELECT </span>* FROM users WHERE <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">id</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">12345</span> AND status = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">active</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span></pre>
</div>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i58.96a07551oiYCIg"><span class="qk-md-text complete">给出一个真实的执行样本，你可以直接拿这条 SQL 去数据库执行&nbsp;<code class="qk-md-code">EXPLAIN</code><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i57.96a07551oiYCIg">&nbsp;分析执行计划。</span></span></li>
</ul>
<h3><span class="qk-md-text complete">5. 使用案例</span></h3>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">5.1 直接分析生成的慢日志文件，输出报告到终端：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pt-query-digest /var/log/mysql/slow.log</pre>
</div>
<p>5.2&nbsp;&nbsp;只分析最近 1 小时的日志，并按执行次数排序：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pt-query-digest --since <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1h</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> --order-by query_count /var/log/mysql/slow.log</pre>
</div>
<p>5.3&nbsp;<span class="qk-md-strong complete">忽略执行时间小于 1 秒的查询<span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pt-query-digest --filter <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">($event-&gt;{exec_time} || 0) &gt; 1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> slow.log</pre>
</div>
<p>5.4&nbsp;<span class="qk-md-strong complete">输出为 JSON 格式<span class="qk-md-text complete">（方便程序处理）：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pt-query-digest --output json slow.log</pre>
</div>
<p>5.5&nbsp;<span class="qk-md-strong complete">只关注扫描行数最多的 SQL<span class="qk-md-text complete">（而不是耗时最长的）：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pt-query-digest --order-by rows_examined:<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sum</span> slow.log</pre>
</div>
<p>5.6&nbsp;<span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i79.96a07551oiYCIg">将分析结果存入数据库（长期追踪）：</span></p>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i79.96a07551oiYCIg">将分析结果写入 MySQL 表中，以便通过 SQL 查询历史趋势或集成到监控大屏</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pt-query-digest --review h=localhost,D=percona,t=query_review /var/log/mysql/slow.log</pre>
</div>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete">注意：首次运行需加&nbsp;--create-review-table<span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i83.96a07551oiYCIg">&nbsp;自动建表</span></span></p>
<h3>6. 其它用途</h3>
<h4 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i70.96a07551oiYCIg">6.1 实时监控当前运行的查询</span></h4>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i70.96a07551oiYCIg">不依赖日志文件，直接抓取当前数据库正在执行的语句进行分析（适合突发性能问题）：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>pt-query-digest --processlist h=localhost,u=用户名,p=用户的_password --interval <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span></pre>
</div>
<ul class="qk-md-ul">
<li class="qk-md-li complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i74.96a07551oiYCIg">--interval 5：每 5 秒采样一次。</span></li>
</ul>
<h4><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i74.96a07551oiYCIg">6.2&nbsp;</span><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i75.96a07551oiYCIg">分析 tcpdump 抓取的流量</span></h4>
<p><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i75.96a07551oiYCIg">如果你无法开启慢日志，但能抓包，可以分析网络流量：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>. 抓取流量 (假设端口 <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3306</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
tcpdump </span>-s <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">65535</span> -x -nn -q -i eth0 port <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3306</span> -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">w</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mysql.tcpdump

# </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">. 分析抓包文件
pt</span>-query-digest --type tcpdump mysql.tcpdump</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
